motion.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Very slow, smooth drift. Background: #F3EFEA, Text: #4A3B32. Font: Playfair Display, text-sm, uppercase, tracking-[0.2em].

page_specific_instructions.global_nav: Desktop links visible. Align left: Shop, Custom Orders. Center: Logo (Playfair, large). Right: Rewards, Subscriptions, Cart.
page_specific_instructions.product_catalog: Use Cardless design for products to look editorial. Aspect ratio 4/5 for product images (`aspect-[4/5] object-cover`). Name in serif text-lg, price in sans text-sm. Subtle 'Add to Cart' button below price. Sections for Trending Now, Recently Viewed, Recommended For You using Horizontal scroll carousels or 4-column grids.
page_specific_instructions.custom_cake_order: Multi-step form layout. Left side: Fixed sticky image of the custom cake (use the custom_cake_showcase image). Right side: The form (Flavor, Size, Tiers, Message). Clean lines, generous padding.
page_specific_instructions.cart_and_checkout: Two-column bento layout. Left: Forms and cart items. Right: Sticky order summary. Very clean, minimal borders. Highlight the total. Minimal distractions to improve conversion.
page_specific_instructions.order_success: Hero section centered, massive serif 'Thank You'. Order details elegantly structured below in a grid. Receipt style.
page_specific_instructions.my_orders_and_subscriptions: Table layouts with generous row spacing. Minimal borders (border-b only). Action buttons (Pause, Resume, Cancel) should be outline buttons to keep it clean.
page_specific_instructions.reviews: Masonry layout or bento grid for reviews. Use star icons (lucide-react). Include customer images or initials. Clean white cards on #FAF8F5 background.
page_specific_instructions.loyalty_rewards: Show tier progress with an elegant thin progress bar. Feature tier benefits in a crisp 4-column grid with their respective tier colors as top borders or subtle backgrounds.

accessibility_and_testing.testid_convention: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-button', data-testid='checkout-form-submit').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure #2C2420 and #4A3B32 text on #FAF8F5 and #white meets WCAG AA standards. Use focus rings on all inputs.
accessibility_and_testing.aria_labels: Include aria-labels on icon buttons and purely decorative images should have aria-hidden='true'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure you build the frontend exactly following these design guidelines. Do not use generic Shadcn styling, customize Shadcn components with these border-radius, color, and typographic choices. Map the provided URLs to the requested images on the respective pages. Adhere to data-testid requirements for testability.
